meta_description: Churchill Decorating Services in Southampton. Expert interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating. Free quotes, local family business.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert painting and decorating. Free estimates, reliable service, attention to detail on every job.
services_subhead: From interior redecorating and wallpapering to external painting and specialist finishes, we handle every room and surface.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decoration
services.desc: Fresh walls, ceilings, and woodwork that transform your living spaces. We use premium paints and prepare surfaces properly for a finish that lasts.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior painting and rendered walls that protect and enhance your home's curb appeal. We work in all seasons and prepare properly.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Precision hanging of wallpaper and creation of stunning feature walls. We handle tricky patterns and difficult angles with care.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting, architrave, and built-in furniture painted to a professional standard. Every edge is sharp and every coat is even.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Office and retail redecorating with minimal disruption. We work around your business hours and leave sites clean.

services.title: Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Artexing, textured coatings, and decorative paint effects. Bespoke finishes tailored to your vision.

about_pullquote: We treat every room like we're decorating our own home.
about_para_1: Churchill Decorating Services has been helping Southampton families and businesses create beautiful interiors and exteriors for over 20 years. Founded on the belief that a fresh coat of paint shouldn't cost a fortune or take forever, we've built our reputation on honest pricing, reliable timekeeping, and meticulous attention to detail. Every job — whether a single bedroom or a full commercial refit — receives the same level of care.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen first, deliver on time, and respect your home. We're not the cheapest, but we're fair. We don't cut corners: surfaces are prepped properly, paintwork is applied to last, and we leave your space cleaner than we found it. Based in West End, we know Southampton well and serve the whole city and surrounding areas.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had our lounge and hallway done by Churchill Decorating last month. Mark turned up on time, worked methodically, and the finish is brilliant. He even moved furniture carefully and hoovered every day. Definitely using them again for the bedrooms.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Needed our external woodwork painting before winter. The lads did a proper job prepping everything and the paint has weathered beautifully. Fair price, no mess. Would recommend.
reviews.author: Helen M.

reviews.text: Wallpapered our feature wall and it looks stunning. They handled the fiddly corners without complaint and the pattern matches perfectly. Professional outfit. Very happy.
reviews.author: James P.
